pages.text: The $(item)Generator$() needs a rotor on its front: right-click it with a Windmill or Water Wheel, Shift-right-click with an empty hand to remove it.

$(item)Windmill$(): needs a free 5x5 area in front, open to the sky. 6 FE/t at sea level, up to 32 FE/t high up; x1.5 in rain, x2 in storms.$(br2)$(item)Water Wheel$(): flowing water in the 3x3 area in front gives 4 FE/t per block, still water 1 FE/t (max 24 FE/t).
